paper_level_summary_zh: 该引用论文在Related Work中将目标论文作为RFID语音窃听领域的代表性工作之一进行列举，未提供具体性能评价或详细描述，属于普通参考文献引用。

evidences.evidence_quote: Wang et al. [23] extended RFID sensing to enable through-wall eavesdropping.
evidences.evidence_context: TagMic [22], built with COTS devices, was the first to show RFID tags could be used for eavesdropping. Wang et al. [23] extended RFID sensing to enable through-wall eavesdropping. RF-Mic [20] uses RFID tags to create a low-cost, hidden, and flexible voice monitoring system, marking an early application of RFID in voice surveillance.

evidences.why_this_judgment_zh: 引用论文在RFID振动感知相关工作的概述中，将目标论文作为通过RFID实现穿墙窃听的一个示例，但未对其性能或细节进行深入讨论，属于普通相关工作列举。
evidences.copy_ready_zh: 在RFID语音窃听相关工作综述中，该论文提及了目标论文的穿墙窃听能力，属于常规文献引用。

evidences.evidence_quote: These studies collectively illustrate that RFID signals are capable of detecting subtle changes induced by vibrations, offering an innovative solution for the security monitoring of smart cabinets.
evidences.evidence_context: RFID stands out due to its compact size, lightweight design, low cost, and ease of deployment, which contribute to its widespread application in industrial monitoring [8–16], healthcare [17,18], and eavesdropping [19–23]. These studies collectively illustrate that RFID signals are capable of detecting subtle changes induced by vibrations, offering an innovative solution for the security monitoring of smart cabinets.
